description: A picturesque fairy tale setting with a beautiful green meadow, a stone well, and lush surroundings.
A scene depicting the two daughters sitting by the well, one with flax and the other with prickers, ready to spin.
insertAfter: Saa blev de forligte om, at den som det først røg af for, skulde i Brønden.

description: Manddatteren encountering the kindling fence, stepping lightly and graciously over it.
insertAfter: Hun gjorde sig saa let som en Fjær og traadte saa varsomt at hun næsten ikke kom nær det engang.

description: Manddatteren milking the beautiful brindled cow, with the overflowing milk and her content expression.

description: The amazing sight of an overgrown sheep with long wool and Manddatteren carefully shearing it.

description: Manddatteren plucking apples from a heavily laden apple tree, branches bending towards the ground.

description: Manddatteren standing beside the old witch's large farmhouse, wondering whether she can get a job.

description: The moment when Manddatteren cleverly seals the sieve with clay and straw to fetch water.
Scene inside the barn, with Manddatteren skillfully managing the shovel and milking the cows gracefully.
Manddatteren choosing the blue chest with the three crosses marked on it, guided by small birds.
insertAfter: Hun tog da det blaa, slig som Fuglene sang.
